input.quote: 10.8 Headings; Counterparts. The section headings in this Agreement are for reference purposes only and shall not define, limit or affect the meaning or interpretation of this Agreement.
input.rationale: Searches for "insurance", "insur", "coverage" and "indemnif" return nothing, and the General Provisions (Section 10, p0059-p0070) run from Notices to Headings/Counterparts with no insurance requirement. HDI is a hosting/services vendor that develops and hosts the Site and, per Section 8.1, has access to Company Content, user information and data, so the playbook expects standard vendor coverage; total absence for a vendor processing personal data is walk-away territory. Inserted a new Section 10.9 at the preferred limits (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M, workers' compensation as required by law, certificates on request), with the fallback (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M) offered in the comment.

proposal.summary: Insert an Insurance provision in General Provisions requiring HDI to carry CGL, E&O and cyber liability coverage and provide certificates on request.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added a standard insurance provision because HDI hosts the Site and handles Company Content and user information, and the Agreement currently contains no coverage requirement. If the limits are an issue, we can accept E&O of USD 1,000,000 and cyber liability of USD 2,000,000.

ops.text: 10.9 Insurance. HDI shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the term of this Agreement and for one (1) year thereafter: commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000; workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable law; and, where HDI processes Confidential Information or user information of the Company, cyber liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000. HDI shall provide the Company with certificates of insurance evidencing such coverage on request.
